main.content:
==English==

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*tend-|id=stretch}}
From {{inh|en|enm|extenden}}, from {{der|en|xno|extendre}}, {{m|fro|estendre}}, from {{der|en|la|extendō||to stretch out}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɛkˈstɛnd/}}
** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-extend.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛnd|s=2}}
* {{hyph|en|ex|tend}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To increase in [[extent]].
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To possess a certain extent; to cover an amount of space.
#: {{ux|en|The desert '''extended''' for miles in all directions.}}
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=1964
|author=Jen Yu-ti<t:{{lang|zh|任育地}}>
|title=zh:中国地理概述<t:A Concise Geography of China>
|url=https://archive.org/details/concisegeography0000unse/
|location=Peking
|publisher=w:Foreign Languages Press
|OCLC=799178199
|page=165
|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/concisegeography0000unse/page/165/
|text=Szechuan '''extends''' from the Wushan Mountains in the east to the Chinsha River — the upper reaches of the Yangtse — in the west.}}
#* {{quote-book
|en
|year=2002
|author=Claire Sermier
|chapter=Eastern Aimags
|translator=w:Helen Loveday
|title=Mongolia: Empire of the Steppes
|url=https://archive.org/details/mongoliaempireof0000serm/
|publisher=Airphoto International Ltd.
|ISBN=962-217-689-5
|OCLC=56598344
|page=226
|pageurl=https://archive.org/details/mongoliaempireof0000serm/page/226/
|text=The sands of Moltsog '''extend''' for some 80 kilometres, and surround a few lakes, such as Ganga Nuur.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To cause to increase in [[extent]].
#: {{syn|en|run}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To cause to last for a longer period of [[time]].
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[straighten]] (a [[limb]]).
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To bestow; to offer; to impart; to apply.
#: {{ux|en|to '''extend''' sympathy to the suffering}}
#: {{ux|en|to '''extend''' credit to a valued customer}}
# To increase in quantity by weakening or adulterating additions.
#: {{ux|en|There's little stew left, but we can always '''extend''' it by adding more potatoes.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1897|author=Alonzo Lewis; James Robinson Newhall|title=History of Lynn, Essex County, Massachusetts|page=155
|passage={{...}} the exalted morality of those virtuous brethren in the trade who, with consciences as weak as their own "'''extended'''" liquors, sought to convince him that to reduce the drink was a mercy to the poor deluded toper.}}
# {{lb|en|UK|legal}} To value, as lands taken by a writ of extent in satisfaction of a debt; to assign by writ of extent.
# {{lb|en|object-oriented programming}} Of a [[class]]: to be an extension or subtype of, or to be based on, a prototype or a more abstract class.
#: {{syn|en|inherit}}
#: {{ux|en|The classes ''Person'' and ''Dog'' '''extend''' the class ''Animal''.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive|US|military}} To [[reenlist]] for a further period.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1993|title=The Leatherneck|volume=76|page=xxxvi
|passage=Two years later, back to amtracs, this time at Camp Schwab, Okinawa, and I liked it so much I '''extended'''.}}
